title: Remote viewing ICBM sites, with drawings checked against overhead photos

tellings.quote: my my area of expertise was ICBM sites okay big large areas where Rockets were in the ground

plain: From the late 1970s through the 1990s, Soviet missile sites were spied on by remote viewing, the practice of trying to see distant or hidden places with the mind alone. The viewers' drawings were then checked against overhead photographs. Joe McMoneagle tells Michels he did this work himself, and that his "area of expertise was ICBM sites," big areas "where rockets were in the ground." If true, it would mean the US relied on psychic spying against Soviet nuclear weapons.
